title: Freeze product scope
action: Record Paper 1 single-binary scope, required B/O/D source chapters, optional features and Paper 2 exclusions.
acceptance: No mandatory task implements rolling, spread, basket or conditional products; source alternatives remain findable.
source: User scope; R §§3–4 pp.5–9; B §3; D §1
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Record architecture decisions
action: Resolve economic, liquidation, index, funding, unit, INVALID and deployment conflicts in C02–C43 with a selected branch and rationale.
acceptance: Each conflict has an owner and status; no implementation document contains two active contradictory rules.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Freeze notation and numeric types
action: Create signed-position, lot, tick, atom, rate, OI and timestamp definitions plus conversion vectors.
acceptance: B x maps to D n and B c to D C−N; tick/lot multiplication and final payout vectors are exact.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Separate mutable and immutable config
action: Assign every configuration field to immutable listing data or an explicitly bounded risk update mechanism.
acceptance: Oracle sources, rules and INVALID terms cannot be changed by risk governance; hazard and cap updates have documented bounds.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Freeze engine and oracle state interface
action: Define separate engine stage and oracle state enums and full transition/function matrix, including failed panels, NOT_YET and timeout Open entry.
acceptance: Every state-diagram edge is callable or time-derived, and oracle Open never reopens trading.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Freeze event and read schema
action: Specify engine/oracle events and frontend views with source identities, units, timestamps, block identity and versioning.
acceptance: A mock dataset populates every required trading, reserve, resolution and claims field without fabricated calculations.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Create cross-ledger reference vectors
action: Reproduce a fill increase, reduction, flip, funding payment and NO/YES payout in B and D notation.
acceptance: Virtual cash and conservation agree after the exact algebraic mapping; incompatible economics stay labeled.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Specify funding allowance consumption
action: Define absolute funding-budget consumption, OI-change reauthorization, sign reversal, OI zero and epoch expiry rules.
acceptance: Multiple rate reversals never spend more reserve budget than authorized; zero OI performs no division.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Specify premium checkpoint semantics
action: Define simple or compounded deficit charging, funding drift handling, hazard boundary updates and first-six-hour surcharge age.
acceptance: A touched account and a long-untouched account settle to the stated model with a proved coverage bound.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Validate risk model domains
action: Add explicit guards for a0+a1, residual epsilon, zero time, margin saturation and reduction discriminants.
acceptance: Invalid domains switch to an explicitly selected safe state and never evaluate undefined divisions or square roots.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Complete resting-order admission
action: Integrate order value sums, maximum fees, funding/premium accrual, epoch invalidation and maker-health semantics.
acceptance: Adversarial resting orders cannot bypass either endpoint margin or outcome coverage after a time/rate/price change.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Adapt Book and Clearing hooks
action: Define callbacks using selected lot types, order tick/value, epoch and premium state, retaining bounded failed-maker handling.
acceptance: Rest/unrest exactly updates Qb/Vb/Qa/Va; size and unit conversions match the reference engine.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Resolve epoch and generation encoding
action: Choose market/account epoch storage and generation overflow policy with selected packed order structure.
acceptance: Stale cancel/claim cannot affect a reused slot, including boundary and generation-exhaustion tests.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Integrate book budget and batching
action: Use a gas-bounded step counter including invalid orders, idempotent cancels and skipped crossing post-only orders.
acceptance: Protocol bound and UI maxFills default are separately exposed; no crossed remainder rests after budget exhaustion.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Implement provisional event reconciliation
action: Join Envio snapshots with live pending block events and confirm/revert by block identity.
acceptance: An abandoned proposal removes provisional fills and restores depth/position displays without duplicating finalized events.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Wire account preview and constraints
action: Expose authoritative order/withdrawal preview including stage, margin, reserve slack, premium, funding and precision.
acceptance: The UI presents the same rejection reason and maximum admitted amount as the engine for selected scenarios.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Mechanize the 1x boundary
action: Select and implement account treatment at the full-backing deadline, including absent keepers and outstanding deficits.
acceptance: The test demonstrates the exact selected invariant across an idle deadline; residual deficits remain covered and cannot be hidden.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Freeze settlement snapshots in bounded batches
action: Freeze common funding/premium cutoffs, account membership and parameter versions; add sweep cursor and completion gate.
acceptance: Changing time or batch order cannot change totals; claims remain disabled before complete reconciliation.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Resolve early INVALID sample availability
action: Define a listing-time rule for early halt/void when the specified pre-T TWAP window is incomplete, and for stale samples.
acceptance: An early halt months before T has an explicit executable settlement-time policy shared by engine and OutcomeVault.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Bind oracle callback authorization
action: Select direct OOv3 versus adapter callbacks and domain-separate panel/review signatures and assertion attempt identity.
acceptance: Wrong sender/domain/attempt and late or replayed messages cannot halt or settle the market.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Complete oracle clocks and terminal transitions
action: Initialize halt/L2 clocks exactly once and make Voided-to-Final settlement atomic with terminal callback immunity.
acceptance: Early NOT_YET cannot cause accidental public proposal/void; every post-halt path is bounded by its stated deadline.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Reconcile treasury and public bonds
action: Separate official assertion bonds, public proposer bonds/rewards and watchdog dispute float, including returned/slashed/stuck funds.
acceptance: Treasury funds never draw from committed market reserve; each bond has one owner and reconciled terminal disposition.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Handle rejected and exclusive outcomes
action: Persist rejected labels and attempt counts, and specify a terminal-safe response to a second group YES.
acceptance: A rejected YES does not automatically become NO; no group has two finalized YES markets and no callback can strand a state indefinitely.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Connect public resolution interface
action: Implement rules/evidence/vote/bond/deadline displays, live dispute and permissionless proposal actions with production/demo labels.
acceptance: Every oracle state renders accurately and user actions call only the allowed contract path with the displayed bond.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Connect claims and conversion status
action: Expose snapshot progress, selected cash/token mode, outcome/INVALID price, exceptional ratio and once-only claim state.
acceptance: An account cannot claim twice or receive both cash and token settlement; OutcomeVault uses the identical INVALID rule.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Run end-to-end reserve stress fixture
action: Execute an early adverse outcome, stale prices, funding allowance exhaustion and reserve takeover through the selected oracle.
acceptance: Before and after both outcomes, held assets reconcile to payouts and retained balances; reserve coverage is checked at every step.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Run all oracle fallback fixtures
action: Execute feed timeout, failed panel, human review, dispute true/false/retry, public proposal and deadline INVALID.
acceptance: Each source-required path reaches Final once with correct liveness and no post-terminal mutation.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Publish parameter provenance and demo mode
action: Record selected parameters, placeholders, measurements, confidence bounds, authority and separate demo clocks.
acceptance: No source placeholder is mislabeled calibrated; frontend and contracts read the same versioned parameter manifest.
source: B §§18,21; O §§8,12; D §12 missing roadmap values
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Rehearse release and operational recovery
action: Measure selected chain gas/finality behavior, recover indexer/keepers after outage and rehearse all alerts using bounded log ranges.
acceptance: Deployment manifest records measured assumptions; services recover without duplicate fills, assertions or claims.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Produce reproducible Paper 1 demo evidence
action: Record trading, reserve-cover, compression, oracle assertion, dispute/fallback and claim receipts with source-mapped tests and limits.
acceptance: The demo shows measured testnet behavior, labels team-mock arbitration and avoids claiming production safety or Paper 2 features.
disposition: Integration decision/gate

title: Resolve the 1x-floor invariant

acceptance: The decision explains pending deficits, takeover progress and exact INV-6/INV-11 statements under keeper absence.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Specify bounded settlement and incomplete INVALID windows

title: Define numerical domain guards

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement rational ledger reference

title: Implement rational risk reference

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement rational funding reference
action: Model old-rate accrual, OI-dependent absolute cash budget consumption and epoch termination.

title: Implement rational premium reference

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement rational liquidation reference

acceptance: All reductions conserve positions and takeover never reduces either outcome coverage slack.

title: Implement rational settlement reference
action: Model frozen claims, INVALID and complete-set conversion, including assumptions-failure haircut.
acceptance: Claims in any permutation conserve assets; converted payouts equal cash for YES, NO and INVALID.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Create invariant assertion harness
action: Encode INV-1 through INV-16 against the reference and contract state interfaces.
acceptance: Each invariant has a runnable assertion and documented timing/scope from the resolved decision records.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement governed market factory
action: Deploy per-market minimal-proxy components from approved templates with immutable question/source/INVALID data.
acceptance: Unauthorized listing rejects and listed immutable fields cannot change through parameter administration.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Enforce supported collateral behavior
action: Whitelist the configured six-decimal USDC token with no transfer fees and reject unsupported collateral.
acceptance: Deployment validation records exact token address/behavior and unsupported token deposits fail.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement vault deposits
action: Credit user free balances only for the supported collateral received by CollateralVault.
acceptance: Deposit transitions preserve INV-1 and emit an auditable amount/account record.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement market allocation
action: Move free balance into one market allocation and atomically credit its engine cash without token transfer.
acceptance: Allocation preserves vault conservation and cannot credit cash twice or exceed free balance.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement release and withdrawal
action: Release market cash only after order-aware initial margin and coverage, then permit withdrawal from free balance.
acceptance: A release that would consume committed backing rejects; successful withdrawals preserve both vault identities.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement engine ledger transitions
action: Store signed lots/cash/checkpoints and apply atomic two-account fills at the actual execution tick.
acceptance: Fills preserve net positions and cash independently of index/mark changes.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement fee and rounding ledgers
action: Route trade fees using configured reserve/protocol split and put fixed-point remainder into reserve.
acceptance: All cash deductions reconcile to reserve, fee ledger or keeper entitlements with no unallocated dust.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement market account registry
action: Assign bounded account IDs and maintain append-only membership suitable for eventual snapshot freezing.
acceptance: Every live position has one registry entry and frozen traversal cannot discover newly added accounts.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement packed order codec
action: Pack and unpack the source fields and resolved epoch extension without silent truncation.
acceptance: Boundary values roundtrip; 32/16/48/32/32/32/32/24/8-bit source layout totals 256 bits; extension cost is explicit.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement tick bitmap
action: Create four-word occupancy per side with bounded highest-bid/lowest-ask lookup.
acceptance: Empty-word sentinel and boundary ticks 1/256/257/999 resolve correctly with no linear level scan.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement FIFO price levels
action: Maintain head/tail, doubly linked orders and aggregate remaining quantity per price.
acceptance: Insert, partial fill and arbitrary cancel preserve FIFO and exact level sums.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement slot reuse and stale IDs
action: Allocate/free slots and bind each order identifier to its reuse generation.
acceptance: A stale-generation cancel or claim has no effect on a newly allocated order.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Maintain per-account order commitments
action: Update Qb,Vb,Qa,Va exactly on place, amend, fill, cancel, expiry and invalidation.
acceptance: Aggregate sums equal enumeration of valid resting orders after each transition.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement fully backed order admission
action: Check both exact outcome deficits are zero for every new 1x order and include fee commitments.
acceptance: The source overselling example rejects and all accepted partial-fill combinations remain fully backed.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement leveraged order margin admission
action: Evaluate adverse execution penalties and IM at both worst fill endpoints.
acceptance: Orders are refused when either endpoint or adverse mark-relative fill violates current IM.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement taker size admission
action: Compute the maximum taker size admissible at its limit with stage, margin, fee and coverage constraints.
acceptance: Admitted size never exceeds a risk/coverage bound and respects tick, lot and minimum-size rules.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement bounded matching loop
action: Walk best FIFO levels to limit using internal library calls, at most maxFills, and cancel crossing remainder.
acceptance: Both ledgers and order sums reconcile; taker final invariant breach reverts atomically; no crossing remainder rests.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement self-trade prevention
action: Cancel an encountered resting order owned by the taker before any self match.
acceptance: Self trading creates no fill, fee transfer or artificial OI.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement amendment priority rules
action: Permit size reduction in place; treat price, size increase, expiry extension or widened permissions as a new order.
acceptance: Only a pure quantity reduction retains FIFO priority and every other amendment is readmitted.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement atomic batch requote
action: Expose one bounded call for specified cancels and replacement placements.
acceptance: A batch uses current admission rules and preserves all order/ledger invariants within measured gas bounds.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement epoch cancellation
action: Invalidate account-wide and stage-wide resting orders using the decided epoch semantics.
acceptance: Invalidated orders cannot fill or retain usable margin credit; stale cancels are harmless.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement good-til-block expiry
action: Reject expired orders during matching and free their commitments/slots lazily or via bounded cleanup.
acceptance: An order cannot fill beyond its expiry; zero expiry remains unbounded as specified.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement reduce-only matching
action: Require reduce-only flags and trim executable quantities to avoid increasing or flipping positions.
acceptance: Every fill in reduce-only weakly decreases each affected position size under the resolved source semantics.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Specify deferred book extensions
action: Create separate designs for index-pegged orders, cancellation-aware deferred maker claims and per-block auctions.
acceptance: Each extension states its funding/deficit accounting and is disabled in the MVP deployment.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement closeout horizon
action: Compute h0+abs(x)/v with measured units and queue-delay integration.
acceptance: Reference matches for 1,000 claims at launch placeholders give six minutes and larger size never shortens h.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement ordinary-move scale
action: Select the maximum of even-flow variance scale, realized index estimate and template floor.
acceptance: Low realized volatility cannot bypass either the model scale or configured floor.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement directional hazard switch
action: Convert each daily hazard to horizon probability and select adverse long/short probability.
acceptance: Longs use NO hazard, shorts YES; probability at or above epsilon forces full backing.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement tail-budget multiplier
action: Compute epsilon-prime and Cantelli k or validated upper-confidence empirical quantile.
acceptance: Uncalibrated zero-jump epsilon1% produces about9.95; no invalid epsilon-prime reaches square root.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement directional no-news drift
action: Compute the adverse drift term with a guarded joint-news denominator.
acceptance: The long/short expressions match the reference and impossible probability rows reject.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement MM and IM functions
action: Combine drift, scale, shock, fees, impact, gamma and directional template cap with full-backing ceiling.
acceptance: MM/IM match rational reference within declared conservative rounding and never exceed worst-case backing.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Expose ledger-derived risk display
action: Produce mark equity, underwater state, effective leverage/cap and offchain solved liquidation-price fields.
acceptance: Display code never feeds entry price, realized PnL or leverage division back into contract safety.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement incremental deficit bounds

acceptance: Against enumeration, neither bound ever undercounts order-aware deficits after a cash or position transition.

title: Implement conservative funding deficit increments
action: Increase both bounds by current-step OI times absolute deltaF and consume equal funding budget.
acceptance: A funding step cannot reduce conservative coverage because one side receives funding.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement exact-bound reconciliation
action: Build bounded keeper traversal that evaluates every account at one frozen funding index before tightening bounds.
acceptance: Partial/inconsistent sweeps cannot lower bounds; completed sweep matches exact enumeration.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement universal coverage guard
action: Apply both-outcome reserve checks to orders, fills, releases, reserve withdrawals and parameter changes.
acceptance: Every accepted transition satisfies Ry>=Dbar(y)+B for y0,1, including reserve-owned position exposure.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

acceptance: Deposits cannot count the same capital as both available coverage and an immediately senior payable.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement notice-based LP withdrawals

acceptance: Matured notices still cannot drain required coverage; premature requests do not withdraw.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement capped shared backstop

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement reserve cash-flow reporting

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement hazard premium indices

acceptance: A rate change never reprices elapsed intervals and full-backing periods have no deficit charge.
disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement exact account premium settlement

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Cancel unhealthy account orders first

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement pair-net reduction

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply

title: Implement conservative liquidation size

title: Implement bankruptcy-price limits

disposition: Proposed baseline; dependencies and decisions apply
